tokens.faq_1_question: How fast can your technicians arrive at my location?
tokens.faq_1_answer: Our average on-site response time across the service area is between 20 to 35 minutes depending on traffic and weather conditions.
tokens.faq_2_question: Are your emergency services available on holidays and weekends?
tokens.faq_2_answer: Yes! Our dispatch center and mobile response teams operate 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year—including all holidays.
tokens.faq_3_question: Do you work directly with insurance companies for property damage?
tokens.faq_3_answer: Absolutely. We provide complete photo documentation, detailed scopes of work, and direct billing options to make your insurance claim seamless.
tokens.faq_4_question: What payment methods do you accept on-site?
tokens.faq_4_answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, mobile payments (Apple Pay/Google Pay), and approved insurance claim assignments.
tokens.faq_5_question: Are your technicians certified and insured?
tokens.faq_5_answer: Every technician, locksmith, tow operator, and contractor on our team is fully licensed, background-checked, insured, and certified in their specialty.
